head: Three tankers burn on Hormuz mines
body: Iran said three oil tankers struck mines and caught fire in the strait; underwriters widened war-risk cover and insurers repriced Gulf transits within hours.

head: Iran sets seven conditions for talks
body: Tehran ruled out negotiation with Washington until seven conditions are met, hardening its position as the Hormuz standoff ran into a second week.

head: Houthis close in on Aden
body: Yemeni forces dug in behind a fortified line as the Houthi advance reached the approaches to the government's seat.

head: Strikes in the south test the truce
body: Fresh Israeli strikes drew accusations that the November ceasefire was already being violated.

head: Oxfam calls Gaza a 'toxic wasteland'
body: The aid group said collapsed water and sewage systems now kill more people than strikes do.

head: 96 drones, 64 of them jet-powered
body: Russia's overnight attack included 64 jet drones; air defences downed most of the wave, the air force said.

head: A Russian drone crosses into Poland
body: Warsaw said a Russian drone entered Polish airspace during the overnight strikes on Ukraine.

head: Estonia warned of 'open war'
body: Moscow accused Tallinn of hostile actions 'on the verge of triggering open war' over plans to close the border.

head: Three children killed a day in Ukraine
body: UNICEF put the daily toll of children killed in the war at three, most of them in drone and missile strikes.

head: China-policy approval falls to 44%
body: Support for Tokyo's China stance slipped to 44% in a new poll before a packed diplomatic week.

head: Local vote tests a fraying opposition
body: Taiwan's 28 November local elections exposed fresh splits inside the opposition camp.

head: MSCI cuts Indonesia to 35 stocks
body: The index provider trimmed Indonesia's stock count to 35 in its latest review.

head: Floods in the south, censure in parliament
body: Flood water spread through southern provinces as parliament opened a censure debate.

head: Hasina plans a 16 December return
body: The ousted premier said she will fly home on 16 December, setting up a confrontation with the interim government.

head: Nvidia chip-diversion inquiry widens
body: Singapore-linked Megaspeed sat at the centre of a US probe into diverted AI chips.

head: Drones strike the capital and its airport
body: The army said the drones were launched from Ethiopian territory; the RSF denied it.

head: Ethiopia offers to host Sudan talks
body: Abiy Ahmed offered to mediate Sudan's war even as Khartoum accused Addis Ababa of backing the RSF.

head: Tigray shelling 'possible war crimes'
body: Amnesty said artillery strikes on towns in Tigray this year should be investigated as war crimes.

head: Another Pacific pact to counter China
body: Australia moved to sign a security deal with a Pacific state, its latest bid to blunt Beijing's reach.

head: Huang is back, and the rally fades
body: Nvidia's reinstated chief executive returned after Trump's intervention; the AI rally faded by the close.

head: Democrats take the House
body: Democrats clinched at least 259 seats, their best result in decades, and made the Huang affair their first line of attack.
